_comment: The live integration tier's roster. scripts/run-live-tier.js runs the
run:true suites; test/unit/scripts/liveTierRoster.test.js fails the hermetic unit
tier when this file stops matching test/integration/, so a new *.integration.test.js
cannot join the tier without somebody deciding whether a venue can actually run it.
Every run:false entry states why in prose, and the runner prints them on green runs
too: an exclusion nobody reads is the rot coming back behind a config file.
Roster set from measured runs (2026-08-09) against genuinely bare checkouts of
xchain-e2e-test + xchain-hub + xchain-indexer with Docker. All 27 suites as one
glob: 84 cases, 61 pass, 13 pending, 10 fail, 926s. This roster as the lane:
20 suites, 64 pass, 0 fail, 0 pending, 703s. Re-measure before changing a verdict.

suites.why: Needs EQUIV_HEADER_ACTIVATION raised above 1 in all five vendored copies (documentation constants.js + hub + indexer + sdk + explorer) for the run and reverted after; regtest ships it at 0, so the suite skips itself. A lane must not edit a consensus constant to make itself green.

RED on a bare venue checkout: the cross-chain DEX PBFT round finalizes on 0 of 4 hubs (expected 4). Measured 2026-08-09 on a genuinely bare clone and reproduced solo, so it is not sweep contention. The hubs log CONSENSUS-INPUT FETCH FAILED for getcapabilityvalidators against a BTC indexer at 127.0.0.1:12001 and fail closed, while this suite's seedStakeSnapshot was written to remove exactly that dependency; whether the seed has fallen behind a new fetch path or the suite now needs a live indexer is its own item. Wiring a known-red suite into the gate would block every push in this repo and train the bypass.
RED on a bare venue checkout, same cause as multiHubCrossChainDex: the weighted cross-chain match finalizes on 0 of 4 hubs. Admit it to the lane with that suite, not before.

RED on a bare venue checkout and downstream of the same defect: its before() cannot produce a finalized cross_chain_matches row, so all three cases fail. It re-greens when the cross-chain DEX round does.

RED on a bare venue checkout in its DEX and XCALL legs (0 of 10 hubs finalize); its other case passes. Same root as multiHubCrossChainDex, and splitting a suite to salvage one case would hide the other two.

RED on a bare venue checkout: the anchor flush case requires every hub to hold a finalized cross-chain match first, which is the same round that no longer finalizes. Its sibling case passes; it returns with the DEX fix.

RED on a bare venue checkout: the weighted XCALL dispatch finalizes on no hub. Reproduced solo on an idle venue, so it is a real verdict rather than load, and it shows the same fail-closed consensus-input fetch as multiHubCrossChainDex.
